articles.title: Qualcomm wants to be the chip inside whatever replaces your smartphone, and it just announced two products toward that end
articles.summary: Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon said Tuesday that the company is working on over 40 different AI wearable devices — including jewelry, earbuds with cameras, pins, and watches — a sign of how aggressively the chipmaker is betting that the next major computing platform won't be a phone.
articles.author: Ivan Mehta

articles.title: Android 17 launches with new multitasking tools as Google expands Gemini features
articles.summary: Google has released Android 17 and Wear OS 7, introducing new multitasking features, parental controls, security tools, and smartwatch upgrades. The launch is also accompanied by a Pixel Drop that brings Google’s latest AI models to its devices.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: Sixty percent of US consumers say ‘AI’ in brand messaging is a turnoff, survey finds
articles.summary: WordPress VIP’s latest survey suggests consumers are wary of AI-generated answers even as companies increasingly view AI search as an important referral channel.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: SpaceX is public: Everything you need to know post-IPO
articles.summary: TechCrunch has followed SpaceX's start, struggles, and successes from the early days. And we're here for what happens next too. This package of SpaceX IPO coverage includes who stands to win (and maybe some who won't), pre-IPO deals, and what's tucked inside its S-1 registration document.
articles.author: Kirsten Korosec, Russell Brandom

articles.title: Payments startup Flutterwave hits $3.2B valuation, backed by Ripple
articles.summary: African payments infrastructure company Flutterwave has hit a new valuation and landed blockchain company Ripple as an investor and partner.
articles.author: Dominic-Madori Davis

articles.title: Plaud says its software business topped $100M in ARR after shipping over 2M AI notetakers
articles.summary: Plaud is trying to make a mark in a crowded market full of AI-powered meeting notetakers.
articles.author: Ivan Mehta

articles.title: Robinhood’s note on 10% layoffs shows blaming AI isn’t cutting it
articles.summary: Unlike many of his tech industry peers who have cut thousands of jobs citing the need to restructure to make the most of AI, Robinhood's CEO Vlad Tenev conspicuously made no mention of AI in his note about layoffs.
articles.author: Ram Iyer

articles.title: Probably raises $9M to build a more reliable kind of AI
articles.summary: Probably wants to prevent hallucinations and factual errors from reaching users, and achieve accuracy on par with deterministic systems.
articles.author: Russell Brandom

articles.title: This startup’s super metals could soon be in military drones, luxury watches, and chef’s knives
articles.summary: Instead of heating metals, Foundation Alloy beats them into submission. The startup has raised $22 million to scale up production of its alloys.
articles.author: Tim De Chant

articles.title: SpaceX to acquire Cursor for $60B in stock, days after blockbuster IPO
articles.summary: The deal is supposed to help SpaceX's struggling AI division. The company told IPO investors it sees a $26 trillion addressable market in AI.
articles.author: Sean O'Kane
